arxiv-2112-01799.title: Global Context with Discrete Diffusion in Vector Quantised Modelling for Image Generation
arxiv-2112-01799.creator: Minghui Hu, Yujie Wang, Tat-Jen Cham, Jianfei Yang, P.N.Suganthan
arxiv-2112-01799.description: Abstract The integration of Vector Quantised Variational AutoEncoder (VQ-VAE) with autoregressive models as generation part has yielded high-quality results on image generation. However, the autoregressive models will strictly follow the progressive scanning order during the sampling phase. This leads the existing VQ series models to hardly escape the trap of lacking global information.

arxiv-2203-06351.title: Rijke tube: A nonlinear oscillator
arxiv-2203-06351.creator: Krishna Manoj, Samadhan A. Pawar, Jürgen Kurths, R. I. Sujith
arxiv-2203-06351.description: Abstract Dynamical systems theory has emerged as an interdisciplinary area of research to characterize the complex dynamical transitions in real-world systems. Various nonlinear dynamical phenomena and bifurcations have been discovered over the decades using different reduced-order models of oscillators. Different measures and methodologies have been developed theoretically to detect, control, or suppress the nonlinear oscillations.

arxiv-2205-04997.title: Random Forests for Change Point Detection
arxiv-2205-04997.creator: Malte Londschien, Peter Bühlmann, Solt Kovács
arxiv-2205-04997.description: Abstract We propose a novel multivariate nonparametric multiple change point detection method using classifiers. We construct a classifier log-likelihood ratio that uses class probability predictions to compare different change point configurations. We propose a computationally feasible search method that is particularly well suited for random forests, denoted by changeforest .

arxiv-2210-03833.title: Fast rotation of nuclei with extreme isospin in the vicinity of neutron and proton drip lines.
arxiv-2210-03833.creator: A. V. Afanasjev, S. Teeti, A. Taninah
arxiv-2210-03833.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. V. Afanasjev, S. Teeti, A. Taninah. The analysis of the present understanding of collective rotation in very neutron-rich nuclei is presented. It is shown that collective rotation can lead to the increase of stability of rotational states with increasing spin. The detailed investigation of rotational excitations in very proton-rich nuclei confirms this conclusion and indicate that experimental studies of such features are more feasible in the nuclei near proton drip line.

arxiv-2211-09614.title: Characterizing entanglement dimensionality from randomized measurements
arxiv-2211-09614.creator: Shuheng Liu, Qiongyi He, Marcus Huber, Otfried Gühne, Giuseppe Vitagliano
arxiv-2211-09614.description: Abstract We consider the problem of detecting the dimensionality of entanglement with the use of correlations between measurements in randomized directions. First, exploiting the recently derived covariance matrix criterion for the entanglement dimensionality [S. Liu et al. , arXiv:2208.04909], we derive an inequality that resembles well-known entanglement criteria, but contains different bounds for the different dimensionalities of entanglement.

arxiv-2404-04002.title: Continual Learning with Weight Interpolation
arxiv-2404-04002.creator: Jędrzej Kozal, Jan Wasilewski
arxiv-2404-04002.description: Abstract Continual learning poses a fundamental challenge for modern machine learning systems, requiring models to adapt to new tasks while retaining knowledge from previous ones. Addressing this challenge necessitates the development of efficient algorithms capable of learning from data streams and accumulating knowledge over time. This paper proposes a novel approach to continual learning utilizing the weight consolidation method.

arxiv-2406-16599.title: Further results on equivalence of multivariate polynomial matrices
arxiv-2406-16599.creator: Jiancheng Guan, Jinwang Liu, Dongmei Li, Tao Wu
arxiv-2406-16599.description: Abstract This paper investigates equivalence of square multivariate polynomial matrices with the determinant being some power of a univariate irreducible polynomial. We first generalized a global-local theorem of Vaserstein. Then we proved these matrices are equivalent to their Smith forms by the generalized global-local theorem.

arxiv-2411-03355.title: Exploring Feature Importance and Explainability Towards Enhanced ML-Based DoS Detection in AI Systems
arxiv-2411-03355.creator: Paul Badu Yakubu, Evans Owusu, Lesther Santana, Mohamed Rahouti, Abdellah Chehri, Kaiqi Xiong
arxiv-2411-03355.description: Abstract Denial of Service (DoS) attacks pose a significant threat in the realm of AI systems security, causing substantial financial losses and downtime. However, AI systems’ high computational demands, dynamic behavior, and data variability make monitoring and detecting DoS attacks challenging.

arxiv-2502-21044.title: Improving error suppression with noise-aware decoding
arxiv-2502-21044.creator: Evan T. Hockings, Andrew C. Doherty, Robin Harper
arxiv-2502-21044.description: Abstract We demonstrate that the performance of quantum error correction can be improved with noise-aware decoders that are calibrated to the likelihood of physical error configurations in a device. We show that noise-aware decoding increases the error suppression factor of the surface code, yielding reductions in the logical error rate that increase exponentially with the code distance.

pmc-11388419.creator: Jie Hou, Yuqi Lu, Qiqi Chen, Xinyi Liao, Xinyue Wu, Kaijian Sang, Jason C. White, Jorge L. Gardea-Torresdey, Jiang Xu, Jianying Zhang, Kun Yang, Lizhong Zhu, Daohui Lin

pmc-13299629.description: Molecular factors influencing prognosis in leiomyosarcomas (LMS) remain poorly understood. pmc-13361508.title: A Critical Review of Longitudinal DNA Methylomic Changes Associated with Treatment Response in Major Depressive Disorder
pmc-13361508.creator: Rosana Carvalho Silva, Danae Zareifi, Danai Giannakou, Antreas Afantitis, Alessandra Minelli
pmc-13361508.description: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a prevalent psychiatric disorder in which epigenetic mechanisms, particularly DNA methylation (DNAm), may contribute to disease vulnerability and treatment response. Epigenome-wide association studies (EWAS) have increasingly investigated longitudinal methylomic changes associated with therapeutic interventions in depression; however, methodological heterogeneity limits comparability across studies.

pmc-13371448.title: Effect of optimal operator positioning on transcranial Doppler acquisition: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13371448.creator: Théophile Vieux, Tatiana Randriamandimby, Roger Kadji Kalabang, Jérôme Bokobza, Rémi Girerd, Tomislav Petrovic, Frédéric Lapostolle
pmc-13371448.description: BackgroundErgonomic conditions during ultrasound procedures may influence both acquisition time and image quality. In transcranial Doppler, positioning at the patient’s head could improve operator comfort and performance. This study aimed to evaluate whether a standardized seated position at the patient’s head enables faster acquisition of interpretable images and could improve image quality.

pmc-13511066.description: Simple SummaryNeoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) can eliminate cancer from the axillary lymph nodes in many patients with initially node-positive breast cancer, allowing less extensive surgery. To ensure accurate staging after treatment, suspicious lymph nodes are marked with clips before NAC and should ideally be removed during surgery.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Within the Ready Reserve of each of the reserve components there is an Individual Ready Reserve.
